purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The national ATR/BPN is the official land registry authority; Purwakarta Regency’s official government reports local ATR/BPN land-office PTSL registration activity. BHUMI is an official interactive land-information map. However, the local SI-DIKA catalog exposed boundaries and irrigation data rather than parcel polygons, and the WUP-point layer/coverage remains unresolved.

officialPrimarySources.observation: BHUMI is the official ATR/BPN interactive land-information map integrated with the ministry’s ATLAS spatial data platform. The local Purwakarta government SI-DIKA map is first-party but the visible catalog is administrative boundaries and irrigation assets, not parcel polygons. Dynamic BHUMI content did not expose a Purwakarta-specific safe anonymous feature query or stable parcel ID/geometry in this review.
